classifications: Theory of computation → Submodular optimization and polymatroids
statement: A number of interesting questions remain. Perhaps the main one being whether the O(log2 (n)) MA gap for minimization can be improved to O(log n)? We have shown this is the case for bounded blocker and crossing families. Another question is whether the α log2 (n) and αk approximations can be made truly black box? I.e., do not depend on the convex formulation. On separate work ([34]) we discuss multivariate submodular objectives. We show that our reductions for maximization remain well-behaved algorithmically and this opens up more tractable models. This is the topic of planned future work.
